rationales.decision-pyramid: The mandate asks for a verdict supported by ranked evidence.
rationales.tension-resolution: The mandate asks which mechanisms explain a business or operational gap.
rationales.option-comparison: The mandate asks to compare credible options on the same criteria.
rationales.phased-trajectory: The mandate asks to sequence prerequisites, milestones and controls.
rationales.practice-transfer: The mandate asks for an observable skill and its transfer to practice.
